subject: Post-demo: buying RACI, legal handoffs, and redline cadence
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rajat Singh <rajat.singh@asteriahealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: buying RACI, legal handoffs, and redline cadence

Hi Rajat / Priya —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum toward the pilot decision. I captured the items we discussed and annotated owners where we were able to agree on one. Please correct any mistakes.

Summary of call:
- Use case fits: clinical workflow summarization + de-identification for downstream analytics.
- Success criteria: 90% reduction in manual note triage time; latency under 300ms for short summaries (SLO internal).
- Timeline target: pilot kickoff in January, production decision in Q2.

Stakeholder matrix (as discussed):
- Economic buyer: Rajat Singh (Head of Product) — primary for pilot budget sign-off.
- Security/compliance: Priya Menon (Security Lead) — will validate DPA and data flows.
- Procurement/legal: Procurement Team (procurement@asteriahealth.com) — will manage NDA/MSA cadence and signature.
- Technical reviewer: Dr. Elena Ortiz (not on this thread) — will confirm clinical safety constraints.

Legal / contract routing plan I propose:
1) NDA: Redwood sends a short, mutual NDA for initial information exchange. Suggested owner: Kimberly (Legal handshake) to Rajat (Procurement). 2 business-day turn target for execution.
2) DPA: Priya to confirm any data residency/KMS requirements; Redwood will send standard DPA template if requirements are standard. 3) MSA + SOW: Draft MSA to follow once pilot scope is locked; target redline window: two rounds, 3–5 business days total.

Next actions (proposed):
- Action 1: Kimberly to share the attached Mutual Action Plan + NDA draft by EOD today. (Owner: me)
- Action 2: Rajat to confirm economic approver and preliminary budget band by 11/06. (Owner: Rajat)
- Action 3: Priya to share any non-standard security controls or vendor questionnaire items by 11/09. (Owner: Priya)
- Action 4: Ben to prepare a pilot SOW outline and cost estimate for the budget band once Rajat confirms. (Owner: Ben)

I attached a light Mutual Action Plan to make sequencing explicit. If Procurement wants to receive documents into a DocuSign envelope or has a preferred template for NDAs/MSAs, flag that and we'll adapt.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachments: MutualActionPlan_Asteria_20261102.xlsx, NDA_Asteria_redline_v1.docx
From: Rajat Singh <rajat.singh@asteriahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying RACI, legal handoffs, and redline cadence

Thanks Kimberly — good summary. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Confirming I am the econ approver for the pilot spend up to $50k. Anything above that will need VP-level approval.
- Procurement prefers DocuSign for NDAs; I copied them here.
- For the MSA, our legal team prefers to review redlines in Word with change tracking.

I'll get back with a hard budget band by Friday (11/06). Priya — are there any showstopper controls we should disclose now (e.g., no external key sharing)?

—Rajat
Rajat Singh
Head of Product | Asteria Health
From: Priya Menon <priya.m@asteriahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rajat Singh <rajat.singh@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@asteriahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying RACI, legal handoffs, and redline cadence

Kimberly / Rajat —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few immediate notes from Security: 
- No external KMS/HSM sharing — we will require customer-managed keys or an approved KMS integration.
- Data residency: pilot data must stay in us-west-2 and be deleted after 90 days unless we negotiate archival terms.
- We have a short vendor questionnaire (10–12 questions) — I'll send it by COB Tuesday (11/03).

For the DPA: please include subprocessors list and a section on vulnerability disclosure response times. If Redwood has a SOC report available, please share it (or a SOC letter if full report is NDA-restricted).

Priya Menon
Security Lead | Asteria Health
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rajat Singh <rajat.singh@asteriahealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying RACI, legal handoffs, and redline cadence

Rajat / Priya —

Appreciate the quick replies. Per Rajat's note on signature mechanics, we'll:
- Send NDA via DocuSign (Kimberly, once you upload, let me know and I'll nudge procurement).
- Attach SOC2 summary and a short subprocessors list to the DPA draft. Laura, can you prepare the SOC summary and subprocessor CSV?

Laura Bennett (cc) — can you draft the short SOC2 summary and the subprocessor list by EOD Thursday (11/05)? We want to attach both to the DPA so Priya can start her review.

Next internal step: once we have the budget band (Rajat), we'll finalize the pilot SOW outline and timing. Target: 1st redline turnaround for NDA within 2 business days, DPA initial review within 5 business days.

—Ben

Account Executive | Redwood Inference
